definitions.gloss: blood sugar level; blood glucose level
definitions.explanation: The concentration of glucose in the blood. A key health indicator, especially for diabetes management and general wellness.

examples.japanese: {血糖値|けっとうち}を{測|はか}る。
examples.english: To measure one's blood sugar level.

examples.japanese: {食後|しょくご}は{血糖値|けっとうち}が{上|あ}がりやすい。
examples.english: Blood sugar levels tend to rise after eating.

examples.japanese: {医者|いしゃ}に{血糖値|けっとうち}が{高|たか}いと{言|い}われて、{食事|しょくじ}に{気|き}をつけるようになった。
examples.english: The doctor told me my blood sugar was high, so I started watching my diet.

notes:
A compound of {血糖|けっとう} (blood sugar) and {値|ち} (value, level). A very commonly used medical and health term in everyday Japanese, frequently encountered in health checkup results and diet-related discussions.

USAGE:
Appears in medical contexts, health magazines, food labeling discussions, and daily conversation about diet and health. Japan's annual health checkups ({健康診断|けんこうしんだん}) routinely measure {血糖値|けっとうち}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {血糖値|けっとうち}が{高|たか}い — to have high blood sugar
- {血糖値|けっとうち}が{下|さ}がる — blood sugar drops
- {血糖値|けっとうち}をコントロールする — to control blood sugar
- {空腹時|くうふくじ}{血糖値|けっとうち} — fasting blood sugar level

RELATED TERMS:
- {糖尿病|とうにょうびょう} — diabetes
- {血圧|けつあつ} — blood pressure; another common health measurement
- {低血糖|ていけっとう} — hypoglycemia; abnormally low blood sugar
